evidence_chain: wwpc-hi-rb013-combined-20260912r3 (campaign_id) ran to completion: status=COMPLETE, 2/2 accepted, 0 failed, attempt_model_outcomes.professionalize_llm.'3'.accepted=2 (succeeded on the 3rd labeled attempt).
acceptance_receipts.jsonl for both cells: campaign_attempt=3, attempt_model_id=professionalize_llm, all 44 gates passed=true, output_sha256 recorded.

Computed sha256 of the ACTUAL on-disk files directly: both match output_sha256 from the receipts EXACTLY -- ruling out any post-acceptance overwrite. The file IS what the pipeline itself wrote and receipted as final.
Both on-disk files still have the frontmatter description's trailing sentence 'Covers Presentation.' left entirely in English -- the identical defect from before this retrigger.

Queried L2 TM directly for the exact same (source_text, hi, campaign=wwpc-hi-rb013-combined-20260912r3) keys: BOTH have a fully correct Hindi translation of the COMPLETE two-sentence description, including 'Covers Presentation.' correctly rendered as 'प्रस्तुति को कवर करता है।' / 'कवर करता है: प्रस्तुति।'. Decoded and verified the actual string (not assumed from truncated output).

Therefore: within the SAME accepted attempt (campaign_attempt=3) of the SAME campaign run, the text that got flushed to TM and the text that got written into the final reconstructed document are DIFFERENT STRINGS for the same translation unit.
ruled_out: Model quality/Hindi-specific weakness: DISPROVEN -- the model demonstrably produced a fully correct translation (found in TM) on the very attempt that got accepted. This is not RB-013's 'single-locale model variance' pattern; retrying on a different model will not fix a reconstruction-layer bug regardless of translation quality.

TM cache staleness / needing a 'replace' retrigger to pick up an old-but-correct value: DISPROVEN by this session's own experiment -- a fresh replace retrigger reproduced a FRESH correct TM entry (new campaign_id in the key) and STILL wrote the wrong file. The bug is not about consuming a stale cache; it reproduces on every fresh run.
Post-write corruption/overwrite by another process: DISPROVEN by exact sha256 match between the receipt's output_sha256 and the live on-disk file.
